notes: Jetcaster's Wear OS client. :wear declares 12 @Preview functions, every one annotated only with the AndroidX WearPreviewDevices / WearPreviewFontScales multipreviews, which the source pre-flight cannot see — hence previewAnnotations. The fork's MainActivity (Hilt) capture failure does not arise: activity captures are excluded from imports, so no patch is needed. The theme is WearAppTheme, declared with wear: true. Two upstream previews are not catalogued: PodcastContentPreview and MediaContentPreview each take a @PreviewParameter value AND a defaulted `modifier` parameter, a shape compose-preview discovery skips (it supports no parameters, exactly one @PreviewParameter, or all-defaulted), so they are never rendered and there is nothing to exclude; 10 of the 12 functions are catalogued. Fixable in the discovery rather than here. Built from UNMODIFIED upstream android/compose-samples (main), replacing the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/compose-samples fork: that fork's `previews` branch carried roughly ten thousand lines of catalog-only preview sources that no longer apply to upstream, and none of them is carried over — this import renders upstream's own @Preview functions only, and every spec entry names one. The Theme control comes from the sample's own theme composable via `themes` in the spec, replacing the fork's re-themed Material 3 tab. Each sample is its own Gradle build in a subdirectory of the repository, hence workingDirectory. Licence: Apache-2.0.
